'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Brandon Stern DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Stern]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
